name: Veggie Pot Pie Soup: Comfort in a Bowl Without the Crust
description: A creamy, hearty soup loaded with tender vegetables and savory herbs, Veggie Pot Pie Soup captures all the comforting flavors of pot pie without the crust.
author: Melissa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or olive oil
instructions: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, cook until fragrant.
Stir in carrots and potatoes, sauté for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir until coated.
Slowly whisk in vegetable broth, stirring to avoid lumps.
Add thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in broccoli, peas, and corn. Simmer 5–7 minutes until vegetables are just tender. <
id=”instruction-step-7″>7. Pour in milk and cream, stir until creamy and thickened. Adjust seasoning. <
id=”instruction-step-8″>8. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
